AUTHOR: Ovegård
TITLE: Estimating escapees using automated video analysis: Assessing the sorting efficiency of the Excluder in the North Sea sandeel fishery
DATA: Own GoPro video at Excluder exit hole (camera position 4), 4 successful hauls of 2022 commercial sandeel trawling
V_EV: Sec. 2.4: recordings 'only classified as successful if the picture covered the exit hole and had sufficient visibility'; Fig. 3: 'insufficient light' -> only 4 of 14 hauls used
D2: Train/val/test boxes per class (e.g. gadoid 7152/579/378); test = 450 images drawn from all analysed hauls by time-series splitting
D_EV: Sec. 2.5: 'tested on a separate data set (Test) of 450 annotated images subtracted from all hauls (sampling by time series splitting...)'
R_EV: Discussion: 'the image analysis conducted during this study was only possible to apply to four hauls, all from the same area and year.'
C_EV: Sec. 2.5: 'confidence threshold ≥ 0.7 (priority to reducing false positives)'; 'To reduce possible double counting ... based on tracks with a minimum length of 5 frames.'
E_EV: Table 5: 'Estimated sorting efficiency of the Excluder by numbers of individuals ... Escapees represent estimated number of individuals ... escaping'
ARCH: YOLOv8 (Ultralytics) detector + ByteTrack tracking, min track length 5 frames
METR: Per-class precision, recall, F1 at conf>=0.7, IoU>=0.5; escapee counts; sorting efficiency
NOTE: V_ALL=N by P1: hauls with insufficient visibility/light excluded without measuring visibility (depth reported). Test images sampled by time-series splitting from the same hauls as training (frame-level, no grouping) -> D1 image/frame. C5 credited for explicit duplicate-count mechanism (ByteTrack + min 5-frame tracks); threshold has a stated rationale only. Escapee counts not validated against manual counts or recapture (catch counts used only to compute sorting efficiency) -> E5 없음. E4=FNR because per-class recall (0.33-0.57) reported and discussed as undercount. YOLOv8 'pretrained' dataset unstated -> PRE NR. ENV: North Sea sandbanks 40-80 m (no fitting value).
